segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Two criminals were crucified with Jesus, one on each side.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: That was one of them, sneering at him from the next cross over.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation? And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But the other one stopped him. We're getting what we deserve, he said.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then he turned his head toward Jesus and asked for the smallest thing he could think of.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: No good deeds to offer. No time left to fix his life. Just a dying man asking.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Today. Not someday, not after you've earned it. Today. The last-minute faith of a criminal was enough.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He saved a man who had nothing to give but a request. It's never too late to ask.
